query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(liters_purchased)/100 FROM fuel_purchases WHERE gallon_number = 1) as total_comprado,
  (SELECT SUM(liters)/100 FROM fuel_records WHERE gallon_number = 1) as total_abastecido_fuel_records,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(liters_used)/100, 0) FROM fuel_record_containers WHERE gallon_number = 1) as total_abastecido_containers;
